purpose: Read-only metadata map for Hybrid AllSky settings product consolidation. This file does not drive runtime configuration, UI rendering, config writes, or Classic removal.

camera_connection.label: Camera Connection
notes: Covers physical camera identity, driver/interface selection, INDI/libcamera connection metadata, and camera row association.
Keep per-camera identity explicit; do not flatten connection fields into global-only settings.

camera_profile_identity.label: Camera Profile Identity
notes: Covers profile id, label, enabled/primary state, camera association, and profile-first ownership.
Protected Modern work; every future settings view must preserve camera/profile separation.

exposure.label: Exposure
notes: Covers exposure defaults, day/night exposure behavior, and profile overrides.
Global fields may remain fallback, but profile values are the product-facing owner.

gain.label: Gain
notes: Covers gain defaults, day/night gain behavior, sensor gain controls, and profile overrides.
Must remain compatible with Auto Gain gating and camera-specific capabilities.

auto_exposure.label: Auto Exposure
notes: Covers auto exposure enablement, target ADU behavior, metering, and profile-aware tuning.
Settings UX should expose concepts rather than raw key names.

auto_gain.label: Auto Gain
notes: Covers auto gain enablement, min/max behavior, target ADU support, and profile-aware tuning.
Do not hide runtime apply gates or collapse per-profile gain limits.

hybrid_awb.label: Hybrid AWB
notes: Covers Hybrid AWB mode, hardware AWB interaction, RGB factors, and camera-specific color behavior.
Must remain camera/profile-aware because sensor/color pipelines differ.

image_acquisition.label: Image Acquisition
notes: Covers capture cadence, day/night behavior, binning, pause behavior, and camera runtime acquisition options.
Needs clearer split between daily operator controls and legacy fallback keys.

image_save_formats.label: Image Save Formats
notes: Covers display image save choices, thumbnails, file type, day/night save flags, and derived output formats.
Must not be confused with FITS/RAW scientific source persistence.

fits_source_files.label: FITS / Source Files
notes: Covers IMAGE_SAVE_FITS, IMAGE_SAVE_FITS_PERIOD, RAW/source exports, detector image paths, and source persistence policy.
Future UX should use Never, Periodic, Every frame, and Event-window buffered concepts.

metadata.label: Metadata
notes: Covers FrameMetadata persistence, source/detector paths, timestamps, camera/profile association, and report inputs.
Do not weaken schema tolerance or source linkage.

analytics.label: Analytics
notes: Covers operational analytics, charts, ADU/SQM summaries, and status rollups.
Settings should link to analytics configuration rather than duplicate chart logic.

quality.label: Quality
notes: Covers quality scoring, stable frame markers, environmental quality context, and future detector readiness.
Explainability must remain visible.

environmental_awareness.label: Environmental Awareness
notes: Covers smoke, aurora, weather, cloud, and other environmental context.
Provider and sensor ownership should be verified before settings are reorganized.

scientific_source_layer.label: Scientific Source Layer
notes: Covers ScientificFrame, ScientificFrameProvider, source image paths, detector image paths, and raw-first semantics.
Display images, overlays, and stretch are rendering concepts, not destructive source-data changes.

timelapse.label: Timelapse
notes: Covers timelapse settings, generated products, and status metadata.
Generation, upload, delete, and download actions remain blocked pending Safe Actions policy.

keogram.label: Keogram
notes: Covers realtime/longterm keogram settings and product metadata.
Generation and download are action-policy surfaces, not settings redesign targets yet.

startrail.label: Startrail
notes: Covers startrail generation settings and metadata.
Generation, delete, and download remain blocked until queue/media action policy exists.

startrail_video.label: Startrail Video
notes: Covers startrail video product settings and public compatibility surfaces.
Public route behavior must be preserved while settings ownership is clarified.

mini_timelapse.label: Mini Timelapse
notes: Covers mini timelapse settings and product metadata.
Lower product priority, but still explicitly owned so it is not lost.

upload_providers.label: Upload Providers
notes: Covers S3, file transfer, sync/upload flags, remote destinations, and provider state.
Remote operations, upload tests, and credential changes remain blocked.

youtube_oauth.label: YouTube / OAuth
notes: Covers OAuth credential presence, upload flags, and sanitized integration status.
Never expose client secret, tokens, refresh token, credential payloads, or raw OAuth data.

notifications.label: Notifications
notes: Covers notification status, delivery metadata, and future acknowledge/delete actions.
Acknowledge is service-ready but execute/UI remain blocked pending Flask auth/session/CSRF tests.

users_auth.label: Users / Authentication
notes: Covers users, roles, password metadata, API key metadata, and authentication-sensitive state.
Mutations require explicit auth policy, confirmation UX, and self-lockout prevention.

logs.label: Logs
current_surfaces: Log download Safe Action policy foundation
notes: Covers log visibility, safe metadata, and future download policy.
Real download remains blocked pending path allowlist, redaction, Flask tests, and endpoint policy.

task_queue.label: Task Queue
notes: Covers queue visibility, task state, action name, payload/result metadata, and diagnostics.
Retry, cancel, requeue, and delete remain blocked by queue action contract requirements.

focus.label: Focus
notes: Covers focuser configuration, status, and future movement/autofocus actions.
Hardware movement is blocked until hardware Safe Action policy and tests exist.

gpio.label: GPIO
notes: Covers GPIO pins, relay-style controls, and hardware interactions.
Do not expose as Basic; hardware side effects need explicit policy.

network.label: Network
notes: Covers host/network settings and OS-level operations.
Network mutations can disconnect the device and must remain guarded.

storage_drives.label: Storage / Drives
notes: Covers storage health, drive status, retention policies, and path summaries.
RPi5-first: avoid unbounded filesystem scans and large table queries.

gps.label: GPS
notes: Covers GPS source/status/configuration when present.
Needs evidence for provider ownership and current runtime usage before redesign.

sensors.label: Sensors
notes: Covers environmental sensors, SQM, ADU, weather providers, and related status sources.
Ownership is mixed across hardware, external providers, and runtime status.

mask_lens_image_circle.label: Mask / Lens / Image Circle
notes: Covers mask, lens metadata, image circle, crop, rotate, flip, and camera geometry.
Geometry should be camera/profile-owned, not global-only.

public_latest_endpoints.label: Public / Latest Endpoints
notes: Covers public latest image/video/raw/panorama behavior and bookmark/external compatibility.
Do not treat as Classic dead code just because static consumers are absent.

config_history.label: Config History
notes: Covers metadata for historical config records.
Raw config contents and downloads require redaction and Safe Action/download policy.

config_restore.label: Config Restore
notes: Covers restore inspection and future active restore behavior.
Active restore remains Classic fallback until preview/diff/rollback/redaction policy exists.

config_import_export.label: Config Import / Export / Download
notes: Covers raw config download, import, export, and restore payload handling.
Must not expose raw config, tokens, passwords, API keys, or secrets without redaction policy.

developer_debug.label: Developer / Debug Options
notes: Covers hooks, debug flags, experimental toggles, compatibility options, and raw full settings.
Keep possible for experts, but do not expose in Basic.

legacy_detector.label: Legacy Detector / Meteor Toggles
notes: Covers DETECT_METEORS, legacy line/Hough toggles, masks, and detector-like compatibility settings.
Do not present this as the real Hybrid meteor detector; real detector work remains blocked pending outdoor FITS validation.
